biggest_catch: This route is in-person local sales only — OfferUp never touches your money and takes no commission, but there's no seller protection either. Cash in person or nothing.

steps: Post the item with photos, title, price, and category (app suggests titles from photos)
Chat with buyers in the app and agree on price
Meet in person (app suggests safe exchange spots)
Exchange the item for cash — no fee is taken
who_pays: The buyer pays you directly in cash at the meetup — OfferUp handles no money and provides no dispute resolution.
who_qualifies: US users 18+; you list items and arrange payment (cash in person) yourself.
work_available: OfferUp is active and open to new sellers — listing is free, no subscription required. Per OfferUp's official support page: 'OfferUp doesn't charge fees or take a commission from your in-person transactions.'
what_gets_accepted: Your listing is accepted as long as it's a legal item; the sale completes when you and the buyer agree and meet. Best for furniture, kids' gear, and bulky local goods — niche items sell poorly to a local-only audience.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Zero fees on in-person transactions — OfferUp charges nothing and takes no commission on cash meetups. Unpaid time goes to photos, listing, messaging buyers, and the meetup itself.
when_cash_arrives: Immediately — cash in hand at the meetup. There is no platform payout at all; you arrange payment yourself.
